mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where GDP y/y growth accelerates by > 1pp.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises by more than 0.5pp over the previous 3 months, it signals a weakening labor market and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and depress S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of periods where FEDFUNDS > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment growth slows by more than 100,000 jobs per month relative to the previous 3-month average, it signals a weakening labor market and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth slows by > 100k jobs/mo vs 3mo avg
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts growth accelerates by more than 10% year-over-year, it signals a strengthening housing market and consumer spending that will boost S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where HOUST growth accelerates by > 10% y/y.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth decelerates by more than 2% year-over-year, it signals a weakening manufacturing sector and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO growth decelerates by > 2% y/y.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate and the consumer price index (CPI) are both rising simultaneously, it signals a tightening monetary policy and rising inflation that will depress S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of periods where FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL are both rising.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP growth and retail sales growth are both accelerating simultaneously, it signals a strengthening consumer sector and economic expansion that will boost S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of periods where GDPC1 and RSAFS are both accelerating.
